examples.title: Squat jump: learning the action, not the recording
examples.tagline: Trained on 36 automatic variants of one clip, the tracker completes 82% of 7 variants it never saw, with 0% falls. The best single-clip policy manages 33% and falls 18% of the time.

examples.title: Front kick: learning the action, not the recording
examples.tagline: Trained on 36 automatic variants of one clip, the tracker completes 100% of 7 variants it never saw, with 0% falls. The best single-clip policy manages 66% and falls 34% of the time.

examples.title: A human body on G1 proportions
examples.tagline: Rebuilding the person on the G1's own bone lengths keeps their joint angles (2.2–18× smaller angle error) and plants the feet: foot sliding drops from 12.4 to 0.0 cm/s, averaged over 7 clips.

examples.title: Imitate what serves the jump
examples.tagline: Arm-waving added before the jump gets the minimum weight (0.10, the same as standing still) while the takeoff push and the landing peak at 0.98–1.00.
